name: Justice Consumer Law
verdict: Paid activity came to a complete halt in the last 7 days, with spend, leads, and CPL all dropping 100% versus the prior period, suggesting Meta campaigns were paused after the 28-day window closed. Organic GBP engagement softened as well (down 23.4%), though GA4 traffic bucked the trend with a strong 71.04% week-over-week lift, pointing to some residual brand or direct search interest keeping the pipeline partially alive.

performance.verdict: Campaigns fully dark 12 days; organic still breathing but pipeline unverified.

findings.text: All paid spend stopped on 2026-08-06 — 12 consecutive zero-spend days; 45 leads and $1,171.64 in 28d spend is now frozen.
3-day lead signal (Aug 14-16): 0 leads vs prior 3 days (Aug 11-13): 0 leads — dark period erases any trend comparison entirely.
GHL shows 33 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments against 45 28d leads — intake pipeline is not converting contacts to opps; this is a CRM intake leak, not an ads problem.
GA4 sessions spiked +71% week-over-week (206 sessions on Aug 13 alone) with zero paid activity — residual branded or direct traffic is real but directional only due to known double-count issue.
GBP actions down 23.4% last 7d and IG reach near zero (-98.76%) — organic visibility eroding in parallel with paid dark period.

suggestions.text: Confirm campaign pause intent with client; if approved restart, reactivate CROA CBO at prior $69/day budget — no increase yet.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 12 consecutive days since 2026-08-06, erasing all lead flow from the prior 28-day window ($1,171.64 spend, 45 leads, $26.04 CPL). Before any budget action, confirm with the client whether the pause was intentional. If restart is approved, bring CROA || CBO - 3/17/26 back at the last active daily rate (~$69/day) with no scale applied. Success check: at least 3 leads generated within 5 days of reactivation at or below the $26.04 CPL baseline, confirmed by 2026-08-23.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake workflow: 33 contacts exist but 0 opportunities created — fix the contact-to-opportunity automation before leads resume.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts logged over the 28-day window but zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked — meaning no lead has entered the formal pipeline. This is a CRM intake leak independent of ad performance. Audit the contact-to-opportunity automation and intake form routing in GHL. Success check: next batch of inbound leads (post-reactivation) produces at least 1 opportunity created within 48 hours of contact entry, verified by 2026-08-25.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session spike (+71%, 206 sessions on Aug 13) for 3 more days to determine if branded demand is real before acting.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded a sharp session spike — 206 sessions on 2026-08-13 and a 71% week-over-week lift — with zero paid spend active, suggesting residual branded or direct traffic. Due to the known GA4 double-count issue for JCL, this is directional only and should not drive budget decisions yet. Re-check on 2026-08-21 to see if the elevated session level holds across 3 consecutive days; if confirmed, this signals genuine brand demand worth factoring into any reactivation strategy.
